CustomField.formula:
IF( ISBLANK(SAPDocumentNumber__c),
LeasingOrder__r.SAPCompanyCode__c & '/' & RIGHT(Name, 8) & '/' & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())) &
IF(OnHold__c, "-OH", IF(Withdrawal__c, "-WD", IF(Replacement__c, "-Replacement", "") ) ),
SAPDocumentNumber__c & IF(OnHold__c, "-OH", IF(Withdrawal__c, "-WD", IF(Replacement__c, "-Replacement", "") ) ) )
CustomField.label: Receipt Reference Number
